reviews.title: Adorable sweater, but sizing is tricky for in-between pups
reviews.body: This little bear cardigan is super cute and actually really nice quality for the price — but the sizing can be tough if your dog is in between sizes.For reference, my dog is a 6 lb Yorkie with a chest girth of about 13.7 inches and a back length of 9.5 inches. I first ordered a size Small, which is listed for 11.8” chest and 9.8” back. It looked great but was too tight on her chest and didn’t seem comfortable.Because I loved the look of the sweater, I decided to try the Medium (listed as 14.2” chest and 11.8” back), which fit better overall — a little loose but more comfortable and better coverage down the back, which I prefer. I don’t like tight fits on small dogs because they can mat the fur and make them stiff when moving around.Unfortunately, the Medium sweater I received had a lot of dog hair on it, like it had already been worn and returned. It seemed clean otherwise, but it was covered in fine hairs that wouldn’t come off, so I ended up returning it. I’ll probably try again and order it in a different color (maybe the blue!) when cold weather comes back — I just hope next time it arrives new and clean.Overall, I’d still recommend this sweater, especially for its cuteness and decent quality — just be prepared to try a couple of sizes if your dog falls between standard chest/back measurements. I’ll include side-by-side pictures of both sizes on my dog to help others who might be dealing with similar sizing issues.
